description: KEY FIELDS (per item): `pos_in_52w.value` (0–1, plus `high_52w` / `low_52w` / `breakout_52w` / `breakdown_52w`), `consecutive_up.days` + `.pct_change`, `volume_spike.median_next_ret_pct` / `.avg_next_ret_pct` / `.winrate` / `.sample_size` (no `next_day_median_pct`), `overhead.supply_days` / `.traded_amount_ratio`. Every block has `observed_days` + `status` (`no_data` = insufficient history). End-of-day technicals for up to 50 A-shares on one server-side methodology. Use scan / limit_up_pool to find candidates, this to vet them. Read winrate only with sample_size, the Wilson interval and excess_winrate — samples are often single-digit.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

name: technicals
